perk1.title: Security by default

experience.description: From intern to full-stack — every stage taught me to build better products.

exp0.description: Owning features end to end on a multi-tenant CRM/B2B platform: KPI, Contract, Order, Quotation and Product Variant modules on Laravel + React/Next.js with SOLID and event-driven architecture. Built Email Marketing Automation (RabbitMQ, Scheduler) lifting lead conversion by 20%; realtime customer-service Unified Inbox via Redis Pub/Sub; Reporting module exporting 50k+ rows without memory spikes. Cut production API latency 30% with Window Functions, CTEs, composite indexes and N+1 fixes; hardened security with CSP, JWT blacklist and rate limiting.

exp1.description: Helped build an online movie ticket booking & streaming platform with ASP.NET Core, EF Core, MySQL and Docker — from database design and APIs to container deploys. Integrated the ZaloPay QR payment gateway into a secure end-to-end booking flow. The internship taught me professional teamwork: code reviews, Git flow and technical documentation.

exp2.description: Graduated with a solid foundation in OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture and the Repository Pattern — principles I apply directly to every production project. While studying, I also led a 4-person team building an AI ID-Photo & OCR system (U-Net, CRNN), sharpened algorithms on LeetCode and shared knowledge on my personal YouTube channel.
